items.comment: Accurate: correctly describes the implicit class as providing `unlift` for `A => Option[B]` functions, and both @tparam descriptions match the type signature. Style is consistent with the file (third person, lowercase tag continuations, no trailing periods, wiki-style links).

"Returns the string `"<function1>"`." is accurate and matches the implementation. Minor stylistic redundancy: "the string" is arguably redundant since the backtick-quoted literal already conveys that; something like "Returns `"<function1>"`." would be marginally tighter. Not blocking.

bonus_findings.note: "the result of function application." ends with a trailing period despite being a single-phrase tag continuation, inconsistent with the no-trailing-period convention used elsewhere in this same file (e.g. compose/andThen @return entries). Outside the reviewed diff, flagged for awareness only.
